r.name: Dunham Massey's Mini Park Loop, Dunham Massey
r.description: Looking for a walk to embrace the outdoors, whatever the season, and whatever the weather? Looping around a small section of the park, this circular walk will give you a flavour of all this nature haven has to offer.

r.name: Get in touch with nature: a wellbeing walk at Dunham Massey
r.description: You’re invited to immerse yourself in Dunham Massey’s deer park & take a moment to reflect away from the fast-paced world beyond the park. A circular wellbeing walk for the senses, soak in the sights, sounds & smells of nature.

r.name: Running routes at Dunham Massey
r.description: If you've got some energy to burn, keep your fitness up with this handy map guide of 1km, 2km and 3km routes around Dunham Massey's historic deer park.

r.name: A Walk from Altrincham Interchange, Dunham Massey
r.description: Travel the green way & help us preserve this special place. Set out from Altrincham Interchange & embark on a scenic route to arrive at the historic gem of Dunham Massey. Enjoy 10% off in the café when you show your bus/train ticket, or bike helmet.
